text:
Fourteen minutes is a long time to wait on a build, so we moved from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. Builds now take 6 minutes, which is less than half the old wait. Developers lose far less time waiting, and it's easier for them to stay focused.

Speed wasn't the only gain. Our monthly CI bill fell from $900 to $410, and that money can go to work that matters more.

The migration itself was painless. Over three weeks we moved 41 pipelines to GitHub Actions. We rebuilt each workflow by hand so it could use the native integrations and newer tooling.

If you're a platform engineer, a backend developer, or just someone who wants code to ship sooner, there's something here for you. Grab a coffee (you'll have time to finish it now). Below, we cover why we switched, what we learned, and how you can speed up your own CI pipelines.
